method: Remaining 82 animated KEKPEPE candidates reviewed in 21 previously rendered four-frame contact sheets. Frames are evenly spaced; all frames viewed for animations with four or fewer. No claim of exhaustive playback for longer animations. All four original KEKPEPE frames viewed in prior static-group report.
